segments.content:
Chapter 148: 0145 The Hype Is Too High, the Server Crashed

The "Campus Love Story Relay" event couldn't have content that was too monotonous.

Chen Guiliang planned to combine his employees' suggestions and hit his competitor with a combo.

First step: Invite a handsome guy and a beautiful girl, take three photos to upload, and pair them with a short text to encourage users to continue the story.

Second step: Hold a Xiaonei.com poetry gathering, in coordination with this story, to encourage users to create three-line love poems.

Third step: Once "The Wind Rises" was recorded, upload it as the theme music for this story.

Fourth step: Hold a "Photo of Love" event, encouraging users to upload couple photos and vote for the best one.

The UEFA Champions League betting game suggested by the employees could also be done, of course, but it wouldn't be heavily promoted. He'd let the users who liked soccer mess around with it themselves.

It wouldn't be good to cast the handsome guy and beautiful girl from just any university. Once their identities were leaked, it would be very awkward for students from that school to create stories.

Chen Guiliang decided to cast from the Central Academy of Drama and the Beijing Film Academy.

Moreover, they had to be freshmen, the kind who hadn't acted in any films or TV shows before.

Xiaonei.com was developing quite well at the Central Academy of Drama and the Beijing Film Academy. Those students were very receptive to this kind of social networking tool. After registering their accounts, they didn't update their diaries frequently, but their photo albums were updated every few days.

Chen Guiliang did an internal site search for the 2004 class of the Beijing Film Academy's performance department, clicked in, and looked carefully, finding that he didn't recognize any of them.

By browsing through photo albums, he chose the most pleasing-looking male and female and sent them an official private message on the site: Xiaonei.com is about to launch a major event and needs one male and one female actor. We will only be taking three photos, with a payment of 200 yuan per photo. If you agree, please send a message to this email address.

Getting 600 yuan for just a few photos wasn't too shabby for a freshman at the Beijing Film Academy.

Besides, participating in a Xiaonei.com event might be helpful for their future.

Next, Chen Guiliang went to look for the 2004 class of the Central Academy of Drama's performance department.

Hm, there was a familiar face.

Central Academy of Drama.

Wang Zhi and Ma Li went to shower together and returned to their dorm building, each going into their own room.

"What are you spacing out for?" Wang Zhi asked her roommate, Tong Liya.

Tong Liya pointed at her laptop screen and said, "Someone wants to hire me for a photoshoot. Three photos for 600 yuan."

Wang Zhi said, "Although it's a little low, it's still a gig. A print ad?"

"It's a Xiaonei.com event. They sent an official private message on the site," Tong Liya said.

"There's something like that? I would've registered too if I'd known." Wang Zhi hadn't registered because she found it too troublesome.

Tong Liya said, "I just emailed them back to accept. They told me I have to be at the Peking University Science Park by noon tomorrow."

"That's not too far. You can just ask for a little time off and get there," Wang Zhi said.

Tong Liya said, "It's just strange. They said it'll be done in half an hour. They also told me to bring three dresses and to dress in a pure and innocent style."

"Half an hour? Then you've scored. A freshman doing a print ad might work all day for just a thousand, but you're getting six hundred for half an hour!" Wang Zhi was incredibly envious.

At noon the next day, Tong Liya arrived at the Peking University Science Park building twenty minutes early.

The male actor was already there. He was a freshman from the Beijing Film Academy named Huai Wen.

Chen Guiliang tossed a T-shirt and a pair of jeans to Huai Wen. "Go change in the restroom. And while you're at it, wipe off the makeup on your face. Don't make it so perfect, you're already handsome enough."

This set of clothes had been worn by Senior Min before.

Tong Liya asked, "What about me? Do I need to re-do my makeup?"

Chen Guiliang glanced at her. "No need. Just take off your earrings. When we take the photos, you can change into a dress. We're shooting a scene of freshmen who just enrolled."

Tong Liya said, "Are we starting now?"

"Yes, we'll start as soon as you've changed. I'll treat you to the cafeteria after we're done," Chen Guiliang said.

Tong Liya glanced into the office and noticed a few employees peeking at her.

She asked for directions to the restroom, went to change into a dress, and then put her coat back on to stay warm.

The three of them quickly made their way to the south gate of Peking University.

Chen Guiliang said, "Male lead, you go ask the gatekeeper for directions. Female lead, you stand by the side of the road with your suitcase and wait for a friend."

The male lead, Huai Wen, said in surprise, "We're shooting with this digital camera?"

"The more realistic, the better," Chen Guiliang said.

The gatekeeper at Peking University was quite cooperative; a pack of cigarettes was enough to sort it out.

"Guy, turn your face inward a bit. Don't worry about showing your face, a side profile is enough for this shot. Girl, come a little closer, you're so far away you're almost out of the frame. Very good, just that expression..."

After taking a few shots in succession, Chen Guiliang felt quite satisfied and took them to the dormitory area.

Tong Liya borrowed a girl's dorm room to change her dress. Huai Wen was still wearing the same old T-shirt and jeans.

They also borrowed two thermoses from a girls' dorm to use as props.

Next, they went to shoot outside a teaching building.

Once the shoot was finished, payment was settled on the spot. Chen Guiliang treated them to a meal in the cafeteria.

It was the first time both of them had been to Peking University. They looked around curiously, finding that it wasn't too different from their own schools, except for the size.

This 600 yuan was easy money. As they were leaving, Huai Wen said, "President Chen, if you have any other events in the future, please don't hesitate to call me. I promise I'll be there whenever you need me."

"Sure, I've saved your number," Chen Guiliang said.

Tong Liya also said, "President Chen, don't forget about me for this kind of work in the future."

"I definitely won't," Chen Guiliang said with a smile.

After a bit of casual chat, Chen Guiliang hurried back to the company to pick out three photos and do some simple Photoshopping.

Huai Wen and Tong Liya chatted while waiting for a taxi by the roadside.

"What kind of event is this?"

"I don't know either. Making 600 yuan in just a few dozen minutes, the more events like this, the better."

"Haha, do you guys at the Beijing Film Academy get to take on acting jobs as freshmen?"

"In principle, it's not allowed, but there are special circumstances."

"It's about the same for us."

They returned to their respective universities. That evening, when they logged onto Xiaonei.com, they were startled to see a prominent headline on the homepage: "My Campus Love" Story Relay, a Pure Student Era Awaits Your Pen!

They clicked in and saw all three pictures there.

The text below the first picture read: At the cusp of summer and autumn, I arrived at the university of my dreams and met TA for the first time. But we passed each other by, not noticing one another.

To enhance the sense of immersion for students from all schools, only the Peking University gatekeeper was photographed, and the school's name was not revealed.

The text below the second picture read: TA and I were outside a teaching building, so close to each other, yet we still missed our chance.

The text below the third picture read: Our first fated encounter was outside the school's hot water room.

He and she are you and I in the ivory tower. Please unleash your imagination and write the most beautiful campus love story for everyone...

"Damn, this girl is so pretty. Does anyone know which university she's from?"

"The guy is really handsome too, okay."

"Do we continue the story in our personal diaries?"

"Read the event announcement yourself."

At this time, Eyou's company address was on Zhongguancun Avenue.

Chen Guiliang's company address was on Zhongguancun North Avenue.

The two were only 4 kilometers apart.

"President Zhang, Xiaonei.com has made a move," said Ji Jiasheng, a Nankai University graduate, as he came to report.

Zhang Fan was surprised. "They reacted that quickly?"

He had prepared for over two months, invited the administrators from major university BBS forums, run internal tests for over a week, and even smoothed things over with the Communist Youth League and the China Youth Daily in advance.

The site had just launched the day before yesterday, and tonight, his competitor had already responded!

Zhanzuo.com's promotional offensive was extremely fierce. It had over 800 registered users on the first day, which increased to 2,000 on the second day, and over 4,000 on the third.

Even faster than 5Q Campus Net's offline promotions!

This was because a large number of Eyou email users were directly converted into Zhanzuo.com users.

The promotional sticky posts on major university BBS forums also attracted a large number of students.

At this rate of development, even if they couldn't catch up to Xiaonei.com, they could still secure the number two spot and compete.

Zhang Fan bent over his computer. "How's the response?"

Ji Jiasheng said, "There are a lot of replies. Xiaonei.com uses real-name registration, so there probably aren't many paid posters. But the event has just started, and no one has written a follow-up story yet."

"Keep an eye on it," Zhang Fan said. "We should also speed up our event. Try to contact the student unions of major universities and have them uncover inspirational stories on their campuses. After all, our event is co-hosted by the Youth League and the China Youth Daily, which will be helpful for those student union leaders!"

Another day passed.

A few Xiaonei.com users had already written continuations of the love story.

But they weren't very good.

That evening, Ji Jiasheng reported to Zhang Fan again, "Xiaonei.com's follow-up event is here."

"A follow-up event?" Zhang Fan quickly sat down at the computer.

Ji Jiasheng said, "Writing a novel is too much for most people. There are many spectators, but few who actually write. This time, they've launched a three-line love poem event."

The three-line love poem event is officially underway. Please use three lines of text to write about the love in your heart.

"First Sight"

No wind,

the banner stirs.

It is my heart that stirs! —Chen Guiliang.

The moment Zhang Fan saw this poem and the event format, he knew the situation was going to be bad.

Sure enough, user participation exploded.

Some were earnestly writing three-line love poems, while others were just joking around and making parodies.

This event had truly attracted a huge number of participants; even the company's own employees joined in one after another.
